name: chart_a_course_discards_without_attack
notes: Pad508e35a0 G4, the twin. Printed: 'Draw two cards. Then discard a card unless you attacked this turn.' Seat 0 goes to combat but declares no attacker, then casts Chart a Course in its postcombat main phase: it draws two cards, then must discard one; it picks the Spare card it already held. Hand 2 -> 1 on the cast -> 3 -> 2; the graveyard holds Chart a Course and Spare.
